about_short_description.short_description: One Codex is a data platform for applied microbial genomics.

product.name: One Codex Microbiome Sequencing Service
product.description: A service providing shotgun sequencing of microbiome samples with results delivered in approximately 2-4 weeks, supporting flexible batch sizes and reproducible analysis.

identifier.value: One Codex Data Platform for Microbial Genomics

product.name: One Codex Data Platform for Microbial Genomics
product.description: A cloud-based platform for microbiome data analysis, enabling sample exploration, strain detection, reproducible bioinformatics workflows, and secure data sharing.

product.name: Whole Genome Clustering Feature
product.description: A tool within the One Codex platform for interactive clustering and comparison of isolates and metagenomic samples without reliance on reference genomes.

product.name: Automated Multi-Locus Sequence Typing (MLST) Annotation
product.description: An automated analysis tool that assigns MLST profiles to bacterial isolates based on conserved marker genes for epidemiological typing.
